# IGMP (`igmp`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 4 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Multicast control protocols](../../protocols/multicast.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) | `protocol` | 2 (0x02) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `17` (membership_query) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | IGMP message type (Auto from the body: 0x11 query, 0x12 / 0x16 report, 0x17 leave, 0x22 v3 report). |
| `max_resp_code` | `uint(8)` | `100` |   | Maximum response time / code in 1/10 s (queries; zero in reports). |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum over the header and everything after it | Internet checksum over the whole IGMP message (Auto). |

### `type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 17 (0x11) | `membership_query` |
| 18 (0x12) | `v1_membership_report` |
| 22 (0x16) | `v2_membership_report` |
| 23 (0x17) | `leave_group` |
| 34 (0x22) | `v3_membership_report` |
